remarks: Nestled on 1.22 acres in the highly desirable Newfane School District, this beautifully updated home offers the perfect combination of modern updates, outdoor living, and direct access to nature. Step outside to your fully fenced backyard (2025), featuring a lovely patio, playset, that stays, with direct access to the trails of Lytle Nature Preserve right from your backyard. There is a second driveway off Heather Dr, if you choose to use this way turn left on Heather and its first driveway on left with carport. you'll appreciate the extensive improvements, including a complete tear-off roof (2025) with a transferable 20-year warranty, new electrical panel with 150-amp service (2025), new living room and laundry room windows (2025) with transferable warranty, wall oven (2025), new grinder pump and control box (2026), on-demand hot water heater (within the last 5 years), Bath Fitter tub (approximately 5 years), newer dishwasher (approximately 2 years), and a new garage door spring. Stay comfortable year-round with mini-split heat pump/A/C systems in the dining room (2023) and upstairs bedroom (2025). The flexible floor plan includes the potential for a fourth bedroom with its own exterior walkout, making it ideal for guests, a home office, hobby space, or multi-generational living. Additional features include a carport, mudroom, crawl space basement with additional crawl space access from the laundry room, and plenty of storage. With over an acre of land, countless updates already completed, and a location that combines peaceful country living with the beauty of the adjacent nature preserve, this move-in-ready home is ready for its next owner!
